parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: DEPRECATED -- the legacy name of the plan key; use the /sites/{siteCode}/... route (ADR 0035). The building whose committed shift plan to read. NOT auto-scoped by site.

parameters.name: shiftId
parameters.description: The shift (within the site) whose committed plan to read.

parameters.name: siteCode
parameters.description: ADDITIVE and optional (ADR 0034). The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1). When given, activeHeads counts only assignments whose associate has an active (not-ended) shift at that site; associates started without a site (including every row that predates this parameter) never match a site. Absent or blank keeps the original behaviour exactly: a fleet-wide count across every site. The code is accepted as given, never validated against facility-layout, so an unknown code simply counts 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, 1-500 (default 100). Empty or repeated is 400 invalid-limit.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque page token from the previous page's nextCursor; repeat the same filters. Undecodable or repeated is 400 invalid-cursor. Any other undeclared query parameter is 400 unknown-query-parameter.
